props.characteristic: one component maps input to output in one pass
props.positive_test: there is one body of parameters and one direction of flow
props.negative_test: there is a second component consuming the first's output, or a parallel tower
props.examples: most classifiers; GPT; BERT; NeRF; SVM; Gaussian process
props.notes: Renamed from `Single stack` on 2026-10-06 (owner). A stack means a stack of LAYERS, which asserts something false about an SVM or a Gaussian process even though the underlying claim -- this model has one component -- is true of them. The axis is NOT misapplied to non-neural models: random forest resolves to Ensemble, so topology separates forests from kernel machines correctly. Only the name was neural-centric. Its two children keep `stack` because they are genuinely layer stacks.

props.characteristic: every position may attend to every other
props.positive_test: the representation at a position depends on both sides of it
props.negative_test: positions may only depend on what precedes them
props.notes: This level was built inside the Transformer LINEAGE subtree by both derivation runs. It is topology: it applies to any family.

props.characteristic: a position may depend only on what precedes it
props.positive_test: the model can generate one step at a time from its own output
props.negative_test: positions see the whole input at once

props.characteristic: a second component consumes a representation built by the first
props.positive_test: two bodies of parameters, with a latent or memory between them
props.negative_test: one body of parameters, or two parallel towers over different inputs
props.examples: T5; BART; U-Net; autoencoders; VAE; MAE
props.notes: Autoencoders live here. An autoencoder IS an encoder and a decoder -- what makes it an autoencoder is the reconstruction TARGET, which is an objective and belongs to algorithms (owner, 2026-10-02).

props.characteristic: parallel components encode different inputs and are combined only at the end
props.positive_test: two or more bodies of parameters run side by side, joined by a comparison in a shared space
props.negative_test: one component feeds the next in sequence
props.notes: Collapsed with its sole child on 2026-10-02: a parent with one child is a rename of that child (R4). Re-split if a non-dual multi-tower family appears.

props.characteristic: many independent models are combined at prediction time
props.positive_test: members are trained separately and their outputs are pooled
props.negative_test: the components are jointly trained parts of one forward pass

props.characteristic: several separately trained components run in sequence, each consuming the previous one's output
props.positive_test: the stages are trained apart and composed at inference; a stage can be swapped without retraining the others
props.negative_test: the components are jointly trained parts of one forward pass, which is encoder-decoder, or run side by side, which is multi-tower
props.notes: Added 2026-10-06. Found twice over: a placement agent flagged multi-stage pipelines as homeless, and the topology audit independently reported stable_diffusion, dalle2 and segnet resolving by parents-column ORDER because their parents disagreed. Distinct from Encoder-decoder, where the two halves are trained together.
